rounds.text: Control Print Ltd presents a compelling value opportunity, trading at a modest P/E ratio of 13.2 [E1] alongside a price-to-book ratio of just 1.85 [E2]. This valuation is starkly discounted when contrasted with the broader sector, where the benchmark P/E stands at an elevated 81.12x [E6] and the sector price-to-book sits at 4.58x [E7]. Operational efficiency further underpins the bull case, delivering a positive return on assets of 6.7% while the sector benchmark languishes at -17.74% [E8]. Growth metrics show solid medium-term momentum, highlighted by a compounded profit growth rate of 19% over 5 years [E19] that comfortably outpaces the sector median profit growth of 10.9% [E73]. Recent operational catalysts validate this underlying strength, supported by positive screen reasons including a 5% year-over-year increase in sales, accelerating earnings growth, and a confirmed multi-year sales uptrend [E63, E64, E65]. Conceded: the stock currently sits only 19% of the way up its 52-week range [E5] and compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months contracted by -41% [E21].
